commercial_events_actor_user_check.name: commercial_events_actor_user_check
commercial_events_actor_user_check.value: "commercial_events"."actor_type" not in ('user', 'platform_admin') or "commercial_events"."actor_user_id" is not null

commercial_terms_templates_approval_chec.name: commercial_terms_templates_approval_check
commercial_terms_templates_approval_chec.value: "commercial_terms_templates"."status" = 'draft' or ("commercial_terms_templates"."approved_by" is not null and "commercial_terms_templates"."approved_at" is not null)

proposal_items_plan_check.name: proposal_items_plan_check
proposal_items_plan_check.value: "proposal_items"."kind" <> 'application_plan' or ("proposal_items"."plan_id" is not null and "proposal_items"."application_id" is not null)

proposal_versions_frozen_check.name: proposal_versions_frozen_check
proposal_versions_frozen_check.value:
("proposal_versions"."status" = 'draft' and "proposal_versions"."sent_at" is null and "proposal_versions"."snapshot" is null and "proposal_versions"."content_sha256" is null)
        or ("proposal_versions"."status" <> 'draft' and "proposal_versions"."sent_at" is not null and "proposal_versions"."sent_by" is not null and "proposal_versions"."snapshot" is not null
            and "proposal_versions"."content_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "proposal_versions"."terms_template_id" is not null and "proposal_versions"."valid_until" is not null)
